name: Assistance to Farmers for Mini Tractor and Power Tiller in Farm Mechanization Program
benefit:
> **Mini Tractors up to 20 HP and Power Tillers above 8 BHP:**

- **General Category Farmers:** Financial assistance of ₹45,000/- or 40% of the equipment cost, whichever is less.- **SC/ST Farmers:** Financial assistance of ₹60,000/- or 50% of the equipment cost, whichever is less.
> **Power Tillers Below 8 BHP:**

- **General Category Farmers:** Financial assistance of ₹40,000/- or 40% of the equi
_eligibility_text: - The applicant should be a farmer. - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant should be engaged in agricultural practices and require mechanization support. - The applicant should intend to purchase either a mini tractor up to 20 HP, or a power tiller (either above or below 8 BHP).
